about: RabbiRabbit study units. A user's passage snaps outward to the whole unit that contains it, and the study says so. Movements are reading guides inside a unit, not cut lines: a commentary piece is never cut, and a piece whose span crosses a movement line is shown under the movement where it starts, keeping its full span label (for example 'Calvin on 1:15-19'). Only a named human approves a unit. Checked by tools/pool/check_units.py.
rule_source: Tom, Nov 23 2026: RabbiRabbit keeps its own units; stories are not cut unnaturally; the weave bridges misfits and labels them honestly.
